name: tripnexo
description: TripNexo - Smart Travel Planning Platform for Rajasthan (MERN Stack | CE-1, CE-2, ETE)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,CLIENT -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev:monolith" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:microservices: concurrently -n GW,AUTH,DEST,TRIP,BUDGET,CLIENT -c white,green,blue,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev:gateway" "npm --prefix server run dev:auth" "npm --prefix server run dev:destinations" "npm --prefix server run dev:trips" "npm --prefix server run dev:budget" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
